claims.text: The empirical evaluation involved training classifiers on fake news and satire articles using various models, including Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machine (SVM), logistic regression, and gradient boosting.
A two-tailed paired t-test with a 0.05 significance level was used to test the statistical significance of performance differences between the models.
The evaluation showed that both semantic cues with BERT and linguistic cues with Coh-Metrix significantly outperformed the baseline language-based method on the F1 score.
